data.name: SurvivalScape
data.detailed_description:
A chaotic co-op survival auto-shooter for 1-4 players, where skill matters more than grind.

SurvivalScape is a fast-paced survival bullet hell, that turns into a bullet heaven. Every run you start with the basics and end in complete chaos.

Battle through endless waves of enemies, collect crystals, unlock powerful upgrades, and survive long enough to challenge the boss. Play solo or team up with up to 4 players online to see how far your squad can push their luck.

Compete for leaderboard dominance, conquer weekly challenges, and prove your skill in a game where every decision matters.

Key Features

Online Co-op for up to 4 Players

Survive together, coordinate builds, and take down overwhelming hordes with friends.

Unique Boss Encounters

Every map features dangerous bosses with their own mechanics, attack patterns, and challenges.

Multiple Playable Classes

Experiment with different heroes, abilities, and play styles to discover powerful combinations.

Unlockable Maps & Game Modes

Progress through increasingly difficult environments and unlock new ways to play.

Boss Rush Mode

Skip straight to the action. Start at maximum level and race to defeat the boss as quickly as possible for the highest score.

Weekly Challenge

Everyone plays the exact same run. No rerolls. No health potions. No Obelisks. Pure skill, strategy, and leaderboard competition.

Obelisks of Power

Risk everything to capture an Obelisk and instantly gain a level. Will you hold your ground or be overwhelmed?

No Meta Progression

No permanent stat bonuses. No pay-to-win upgrades. Every run begins on equal footing, rewarding player skill over grind.

Twitch Integration

Let your Twitch chat vote on upgrades, influence your build, and create unpredictable runs.

Full Controller & Ultrawide Support

Built to play comfortably whether you're on a controller, keyboard and mouse, or an ultrawide display.

Every Run Tells a Story

Whether you're climbing the leaderboards, chasing a new Boss Rush record, tackling the Weekly Challenge, or surviving alongside friends in co-op, SurvivalScape delivers endless opportunities to improve, experiment, and push for one more run.
